text.text: Seared Fuel Tanks and Fuel Gauges can hold 4,000 mB of fluid. A compatible fuel tank in the smeltery wall supplies fuel for melting.
Supported held containers and faucets can transfer fluid to compatible tanks. The available endpoints and fluid metadata are limited in this version.
The original tank item showcase is not available here. Potion handling, pistons and dispensers have not been verified in game.
